relationships.subject: Suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: Suzetrigine is a non-opioid, highly selective NaV1.8 pain-signal inhibitor of the voltage-gated sodium channel NaV1.8

relationships.subject: Suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: Most patients (90.7%) rated suzetrigine as part of MMT as good/very good/excellent on a PGA for pain control at end of treatment

key_findings: In a phase 4 single-arm study (N=99), 90.7% rated suzetrigine-containing multimodal therapy good to excellent for pain control after aesthetic/reconstructive surgery.
90.9% of patients did not require opioid rescue.
